danieljwilson/16sub16.summary: The repository implements a fitness tracking system using the Banister impulse-response model, integrating data from both Strava and TrainingPeaks. Recent work focused on building an automated pipeline that fetches training data, fits the Banister model to calculate fitness and fatigue metrics, and visualizes the results through a GitHub Pages site (index.html). Multiple commits refined the UI/UX, adjusted model parameters, and established automated updates via GitHub Actions.
next_steps: • Add documentation explaining the Banister model parameters (tau1, tau2, k1, k2) and how users can interpret their fitness/fatigue curves
• Implement error handling and validation for the Strava and TrainingPeaks API integrations to handle rate limits and missing data
• Add unit tests for the Banister model fitting logic in update_banister.py to ensure accuracy of projections
• Consider adding user configuration options to customize model parameters or data sources without modifying code
• Explore additional visualizations such as form (fitness minus fatigue) or performance predictions for upcoming race dates
